rationale: Wind-caused damage to the policyholder's own roof structure is a straightforward property damage claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee reports four roof shingles blown off the back porch overhang by wind last weekend. Estimated repair cost $400 with no interior water damage. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not result in coverage.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no interior water damage
